item.title: Charleston Battery’s 2026 home opener set for March 7 against reigning champs Pittsburgh
item.description: The USL Championship confirmed Thursday the slate of home openers for the 2026 regular season. The Charleston Battery are set to host Pittsburgh Riverhounds SC on Sat., March 7, at Patriots Point (kickoff time TBD) to kick off the new campaign.
